name: Pegs and Jokers
description: Pegs and Jokers is a North American partnership race game. Cards move pegs (or marbles) around a board. 4, 6, or 8 players; each player has 5 pegs. First team to move all pegs from START to HOME wins. Derived from Pachisi/Sorry.

overview.description: Pegs and Jokers is a North American partnership race game. Cards move pegs (or marbles) around a board. 4, 6, or 8 players; each player has 5 pegs. First team to move all pegs from START to HOME wins. Derived from Pachisi/Sorry.

history.origins: Derived from Pachisi via Sorry!. Cards control movement instead of dice. Based on Bill and Barb Bigger, John and Linda Bristol.
history.cultural: Family/party game; boards from Wizard Woodworks, Three Trees.
history.evolution: Basic vs Arizona Rules. Home-made boards common.

setup.players: 4, 6, or 8 in two teams. Sit alternately (or opposite in 6/8).
setup.equipment: Board (4/6/8 sides), 5 pegs per player (or marbles).

rules.objective: Each player has five pegs; the winners are the first team to move all their pegs from their START area to their HOME areas.
rules.gameplay: 1. Draw 1, play 1, move. 2. To come out: Jack/Q/K/Ace or Joker. 3. 2-6, 9-10: move forward that many. Ace: come out or move 1. J/Q/K: come out or move 10. 7: forward 7 or split between 2 pegs. 8: move backward 8. Joker: jump to opponent/partner peg (sends opponent to start, partner to in-spot). 4. Land on opponent = send to start; land on partner = send to in-spot. 5. Must play a moving card if possible; Joker never forced.
keyRules: 5 pegs each. Come out, go around, turn into HOME at in-spot.
Joker: jump to any peg of different color; cannot move to empty hole.
Arizona: play then draw; move any team peg; 9 can split forward/back.
All five home = move partner's pegs.

strategy.basic: After come-out, move 1-3 forward before using 8 backward to reach in-spot.
strategy.intermediate: Runner peg: move 4+ forward, use 8; harass opponents. Home run: partner lands on your peg at come-out, sends you to in-spot.
strategy.advanced: Double play: peg in come-out; partner's runner lands, sends it home. Chain reactions with 7/9 splits.
tips: Joker: target opponent pegs near home.
